- [USER] User asked, "how to connect tradingview to my website?"
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To connect TradingView to your website, you can use the TradingView Widget to embed real-time charts, quotes, and other financial data.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Steps to embed the TradingView Widget:
  1. Go to the TradingView website and sign up for a free account.
  2. Click on the "Chart" button at the top of the TradingView page.
  3. Customize your chart with the tools and indicators you want to use.
  4. Click on the "Publish" button at the top of the chart and select "Embed Chart."
  5. Customize the settings for the widget, such as size, colors, and symbols.
  6. Copy the embed code provided by TradingView.
  7. Paste the embed code into your website's HTML code where you want the widget to appear.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Once embedded, users will be able to view real-time financial data and charts directly on your site.
